intro.text: A small mining region of Jah Keved, on Roshar. Its people are called Bav or Bavlanders.

description.text: A dusty land rich in ore, where mining villages with large numbers of transient workers provide most of the work. Even so, its towns are small: Ironsway, one of the bigger ones, has only a few hundred homes and three taverns.
Outsiders call the people of Bavland Bavlanders, but they call themselves Bav. Though Vorin, they have a culture distinct from the Veden one.
The Bav have a language of their own, spoken in several dialects. In the Ironsway dialect, a child is a kurp.
Spoken Bav sounds as though the speaker's mouth is full of pebbles. Tyn trained Shallan in the accent, which is a good one for anyone hoping to avoid notice.
The rest of Jah Keved largely ignores Bavland, and even the highprince with authority over it stays away; the Alethi dismiss it as a backwater.
